front: Employees must sign in once to many AWS accounts with their corporate identity provider, with the LEAST operational overhead. What do you use?
back: IAM Identity Center, with a permission set for each account.
extra: IAM Identity Center gives employees single sign-on, [including any AWS accounts that are assigned](../facts/iam-identity-center.md#iam-identity-center-workforce-sso-to-accounts-and-applications) to them.

front: In Amazon Cognito, user pool or identity pool: which one gives the app temporary AWS credentials?
extra: A user pool can [issue JSON web tokens (JWTs)](../facts/cognito.md#cognito-user-pool-vs-identity-pool); an identity pool returns [temporary, limited-privilege AWS credentials](../facts/cognito.md#cognito-user-pool-vs-identity-pool).

front: In AWS Directory Service, AD Connector or AWS Managed Microsoft AD: which one keeps no directory data in AWS?
back: AD Connector. It forwards each sign-in to your domain.
extra: With AD Connector, AWS [does not replicate any of your directory data](../facts/directory-service.md#directory-service-ad-connector-no-data-replicated).

front: In IAM Identity Center, a new permission set has a session duration of {{c1::1 hour}} by default.
In IAM Identity Center, a sign-in to the AWS access portal lasts {{c1::8 hours}} by default.
In AWS Directory Service, AWS creates a minimum of {{c1::two domain controllers}} for each AWS Managed Microsoft AD directory.
In Amazon Cognito, AWS credentials from an identity pool in the enhanced flow are {{c1::valid for one hour}}.
In Amazon Cognito, a user pool refresh token expires {{c1::30 days}} after sign-in by default.
In IAM Identity Center, can a Cognito user pool be the identity source for employees?
back: No. Cognito is for the users of your apps.
extra: Amazon Cognito is [not a supported identity source](../facts/iam-identity-center.md#iam-identity-center-cognito-is-not-an-identity-source) for IAM Identity Center.

front: In IAM Identity Center, can Okta and Active Directory be identity sources at the same time?
back: No. One instance connects one identity source at a time.
extra: IAM Identity Center connects [only one directory or one SAML 2.0 identity provider](../facts/iam-identity-center.md#iam-identity-center-one-identity-source-at-a-time) at a time.

front: In AWS Directory Service, can Simple AD have a trust relationship with an on-premises domain?
back: No. Use AWS Managed Microsoft AD for a trust.
extra: Simple AD [does not support multi-factor authentication (MFA), trust relationships](../facts/directory-service.md#directory-service-simple-ad-unsupported-features).

front: In IAM Identity Center with AWS Managed Microsoft AD, does a one-way trust to the on-premises domain work for sign-in?
back: No. IAM Identity Center needs a two-way trust.
extra: [One-way trusts do not work](../facts/iam-identity-center.md#iam-identity-center-needs-two-way-trust-not-one-way) with IAM Identity Center.
